name: simple-calc
description: A minimal, local-first spreadsheet editor with broad workbook compatibility.
author: simple_calc

scripts.test: npm run test:workbooks && npm run test:legacy-xls && npm run test:legacy-xls-layout && npm run test:readability && npm run test:save-policy && npm run test:fidelity && npm run test:formulas && npm run test:calc-engine && npm run test:goal-seek && npm run test:sparkline && npm run test:formula-editing && npm run test:input-parsing && npm run test:number-format && npm run test:format-codes && npm run test:conditional-format && npm run test:data-tools && npm run test:validation-xlsx && npm run test:clipboard-html && npm run test:charts && npm run test:tables && npm run test:outline && npm run test:images && npm run test:pivot && npm run test:protection && npm run test:structure && npm run test:cell-drag && npm run test:validation-dropdown && npm run test:clipboard && npm run test:grid-navigation && npm run test:polish && npm run test:print && npm run test:direct-print && npm run test:exports && npm run test:delimited && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:formulas: node --no-warnings --experimental-transform-types scripts/qa-formulas.ts && node --no-warnings --experimental-transform-types scripts/qa-formula-engine.ts && node --no-warnings --experimental-transform-types scripts/qa-formula-library.ts
scripts.test:outline: esbuild scripts/qa-outline.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=tmp/qa-outline.mjs --log-level=warning && node tmp/qa-outline.mjs && node scripts/qa-outline-xlsx.cjs
scripts.test:pivot: esbuild scripts/qa-pivot.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=tmp/qa-pivot.mjs --log-level=warning && node tmp/qa-pivot.mjs && node scripts/qa-pivot-xlsx.cjs
scripts.test:sparkline: esbuild scripts/qa-sparkline.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=tmp/qa-sparkline.mjs --log-level=warning && node tmp/qa-sparkline.mjs && node scripts/qa-sparkline-xlsx.cjs
scripts.test:protection: esbuild scripts/qa-protection.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=tmp/qa-protection.mjs --log-level=warning && node tmp/qa-protection.mjs && node scripts/qa-protection-xlsx.cjs
scripts.test:tables: esbuild scripts/qa-tables.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=tmp/qa-tables.mjs --log-level=warning && node tmp/qa-tables.mjs && node scripts/qa-table-xlsx.cjs
scripts.test:polish: esbuild scripts/qa-polish.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=tmp/qa-polish.mjs --log-level=warning && node tmp/qa-polish.mjs && node scripts/qa-polish-xlsx.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-portable-build.cjs && electron-builder --win portable --x64
